name: nih-reporter-scraper
title: NIH RePORTER Scraper – No 15k Row Cap, PubMed Join
description: Search NIH-funded research projects via the official NIH RePORTER API: keyword, fiscal year, institute, activity code, organization, state, PI and award-amount filters, plus an optional PubMed join. Auto-chunks past the API's 15,000-row wall. Watch mode returns only what's new since your last run.
